terra.problem: The passage says money was brought out, but does not say it was coins.
Calling the ark holy is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying Joshua doesn't mind assigns him a feeling the text does not give.
The explanation guesses why Shaphan gave his report. Reasons cannot be added, even when marked as a guess.
The passage says Shaphan read the book in the king's presence, but does not say he read it word for word.
The statement about tearing clothes to show distress is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Saying Josiah does not make a plan on his own adds something the passage does not say.
Saying the king isn't thinking about printing assigns him a thought the text does not give.
The joke assumes the book had been kept in dark places, which the passage does not say.
The explanation is flat and generic. Saying the king is still king and busy adds little to the answer.
